658:t_2:49.en:
$$隼人$$
「So that was the result of $$竜馬$$ drawing out $$真ゲッター$$'s power to the fullest.」

658:t_2:51.en:
$$竜馬$$
(That feeling then... was different from when I used Stoner or Shine Spark...)

658:t_2:52.en:
$$竜馬$$
(It was as though I'd become completely one with the machine called $$ゲッター$$...)

658:t_2:53.en:
$$竜馬$$
(What was that feeling...? And just what was that power...?)

658:t_10:4.en:
$$號$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... Did we produce some good $$Ｚチップ$$s?」

658:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We certainly did! Your exhilaration when you defeated that giant $$インベーダー#pilot$$ produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

658:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add these to the squad's reserves.」

658:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It makes me happy. Everyone speaks so ill of me for collecting $$Ｚチップ$$s, but you alone understand, $$號$$.」

658:t_10:9.en:
$$號$$
「That power will lead us to a new stage... That's what I believe.」

658:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I'm hardly one to talk, but his existence is full of mysteries too...)

658:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$トライア$$... You've come to visit $$Ｄトレーダー$$ when you're so busy...」

658:t_10:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the flattery. ...How's our $$Ｚチップ$$ collection coming along?」

658:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We've managed to reach our target. I believe the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ can now deliver the power we seek.」

658:t_10:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then I'll start getting things ready on my end too.」

658:t_10:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though we may not even get a chance to play this trump card...」

658:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no point in being pessimistic! At a time like this, we need a pick-me-up!」

658:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Heh... Once you try saying it, it really is addictive.」

659:t_001:2.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「From this moment on, the void will reign over this space.」

659:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So it's the same as $$尸空#pilot$$.」

659:t_001:5.en:
$n
「But those two don't have dead emotions like $$尸空#pilot$$ does...!」

659:t_001:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「They aren't the void. This space is the void.」

659:t_001:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't really get what you're saying!」

659:t_001:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$ draws his power from the void... But normally, even if that part exists within a person, it never surfaces.」

659:t_001:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Because in a sense... it's the same as death.」

659:t_001:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「Death... It lies at the opposite pole from life... from living human beings, in other words...」

659:t_001:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$尸刻$$ belonged to a race with the power to guide the souls of the dead.」

659:t_001:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's probably why he could activate a $$スフィア$$ of the void, something ordinary humans could never reach.」

659:t_001:13.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Just what I'd expect of a $$スフィア・リアクター$$. It seems you understand a little of the nature of the void... of the Great Void.」

659:t_001:14.en:
$$隼人$$
「The Great Void... Would you call it the state of nothingness before the universe began...?」

659:t_001:15.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Our bodies contain an element of the Great Void... of a world governed by a different natural order from this one.」

659:t_001:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「So even when you were exposed to $$ゲッター線$$, you evolved in the exact opposite direction from humans...!」

659:t_002:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No matter how much power you gain, your destiny is to never evolve beyond lowly creatures driven by hunger and the urge to destroy!」

659:t_002:3.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「So you've come, damn $$御使い$$!」

659:t_002:4.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「You're the one who called us $$バアル$$ and contrived to turn other life-forms against us!」

659:t_002:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But you brought that on yourselves.」

659:t_002:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Even after receiving the power of $$ゲッター線$$, all you do is follow your instincts and attack every species but your own.」

659:t_002:8.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You can't reach the truth that way... Basically, $$シンカ$$ is a dream beyond your wildest dreams.」

659:t_002:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You'll be ravenous destroyers forever... However much power you have, you can never attain $$シンカ$$, and ultimately, you can never become 'gods.'」

659:t_002:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then the role that suits you is 'demons'... In other words, $$バアル$$.」

659:t_002:12.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And if you've even absorbed an element of the Great Void... of the force that seeks to vanish, you're no different from those $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

659:t_002:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The force that seeks to vanish... It's the opposite concept to the force that seeks to exist...」

659:t_002:14.en:
$$桂$$
「Are you saying that thing called the Great Void causes the universe's great collapse once every 120 million years?!」

659:t_002:16.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Damn $$御使い$$! Don't think you can do whatever you like with us!」

659:t_002:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Ahahaha! You're awfully bold inside the Great Void's space!」

659:t_002:18.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then I'll lend you a hand, so go ahead and try wiping out the Earthlings!」

659:t_003:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't be fooled by her appearance! She's one of the $$御使い$$s too!」

659:t_003:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right. You couldn't beat $$テンプティ$$ no matter how hard you tried.」

659:t_003:3.en:
$n
「So you puff yourselves up with arrogance and play at being rulers?!」

659:t_003:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We're not playing at anything. It's just a fact.」

659:t_003:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Bye-bye, Earthlings! Can you beat the tag team of ravenous destroyers and incarnations of endless destruction?!」

659:t_004:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「But this is our chance! Now we can fulfill our long-cherished wish!」

659:t_005:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「So the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ have come out too!」

659:t_005:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's the whole $$バアル$$ lineup!」

659:t_005:3.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Do not call us $$バアル$$!」

659:t_005:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「As long as you keep acting like that, you really are $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_005:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「As long as you keep acting like that, you really are $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_005:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「As long as you keep acting like that, you really are $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_005:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「We cannot coexist with beings who refuse to understand others and do nothing but spread destruction!」
